body: My friend Joy C. Wallis – the real-life Vicar of Dibley, for BBC/PBS fans – is a gifted speaker and writer. For many years she has been immersed in life as a mom, baseball afficionado, and wife of Jim Wallis, but I was thrilled to learn recently that she’s ready to get back out on the road and share her spiritual wit and wisdom with people. If you’re looking for a great speaker and all-around interesting person (and board chair of the Wild Goose Festival  to boot), check out her new website.
